status: Frozen before training and control generation.

evidence.interpretation: Supplying the shared prefix improves entry and syntax; complete reviews still need training in citations, reasons and completion. This selects complete-answer supervision as the next objective comparison.

fixed_training.initialization: Fresh adapters on the same verified base; use the same seed as the comparator.
fixed_training.training_rows: The same 40 explicitly paired review rows from the unchanged 64-row v2 corpus.
fixed_training.adapter_targets: Final-layer MLP gate, up and down projections.
fixed_training.data_phase: v3 wording changes form a subsequent data comparison.

objective.decision_loss: L_decision = (1/40) * sum CE over the existing mapped decision positions.
objective.residual_loss: L_residual = (1/792) * sum CE over every remaining review-answer target, including prefix, line ID, reason, closing syntax and EOS.
objective.partition: The two sets are disjoint and cover all 832 review-answer targets exactly once.
objective.update_interpretation: The decision coefficient stays 1/40. The auxiliary gradient contributes to the combined norm, clipping and Adam moments.

gradient_accumulation.method: Hold parameters fixed while accumulating weighted gradients across all 832 target positions. Apply one global clip and one Adam step after the complete accumulation.
gradient_accumulation.normalization: Each microbatch contributes the sum of per-token CE multiplied by its global coefficient, 1/40 or 1/792. Rescale any locally normalized CE by the appropriate coefficient mass before accumulating.
gradient_accumulation.remainder: Include the final partial microbatch with its actual coefficient mass.
gradient_accumulation.validation: Compare accumulated loss and parameter gradients with a single-batch reference on a small mixed-group fixture, including a partial final microbatch.

checkpoint_selection.rule: Maximize complete decision pairs, then full-vocabulary target hits, then earlier eligible update.
checkpoint_selection.scope: Keep the comparator selector; prefix and whole-answer results are additional measurements.

every_update: Decision CE, residual CE and combined loss.
Combined gradient norm before clipping, applied clip scale and clipping event.
The existing 40 decision targets: full-vocabulary hits, complete pairs and target margins.
at_full_snapshots: Per-position prefix hits and complete three-token-prefix hits on the 40 reviews.
Teacher-forced token accuracy and exact answers across all 64 corpus rows.
after_selection: Natural generation for the same 40 review training prompts and 12 diagnostics.
Shared-prefix continuation on both sides of all 20 review pairs.
Complete JSON syntax, production parsing, finding presence, citations, reason meaning, EOS and full-pair correctness.
readouts.summary: Report clipping frequency and each loss component alongside the unchanged selection metrics.

emitted_token_trace.source: Actual token IDs selected inside the native generation loop before decoding.
record: Model, prompt and runner source hashes.
emitted_token_trace.comparison: Compare the first emitted ID after the shared prefix with the teacher-forced full-vocabulary winner; score the complete generated review separately.
emitted_token_trace.current_evidence: The completed shared-prefix probe records response semantics. The planned runner trace adds direct emission identity.

evaluation.schedule: Control generation may overlap training; joint generation starts after training finishes.
evaluation.trace: Actual native prompt and sampled token IDs including terminal EOS are embedded in every result row.
